list_shipping_profiles.code:
response = client.shipping_profiles.list_shipping_profiles({"search": "metro", "sort": "name", "order": "asc", "limit": 20})
for profile in response.map["shipping_profiles"]:
    print(profile["id"], profile["name"], profile["rule_preference"], profile["default"])
print(response.map["pagination"]["has_next"])

get_shipping_profile.code:
response = client.shipping_profiles.get_shipping_profile(12)
profile = response.map["shipping_profile"]
print(profile["name"], profile["rule_preference"], profile["default"])
for rule in profile["shipping_rules"]:
    print(rule["id"], rule["name"], rule["shipping_rate"]["name"])

patch_shipping_profile.code:
response = client.shipping_profiles.patch_shipping_profile(12, {"shipping_profile": {"default": True}})
profile = response.map["shipping_profile"]
print(profile["name"], profile["default"])
